skill.summary: Detect and analyze emerging viral trends across 10 social platforms simultaneously, generate content briefs, and produce ready-to-publish videos in 20 minutes.

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Viral Content Research Engine v1.0.0 — Instantly detects cross-platform trends before they peak and generates ready-to-publish content.

- Simultaneously deploys 10 Apify scrapers to monitor TikTok, Reddit, Twitter, YouTube, Google Trends, Instagram, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Google News, and Quora for early viral signals.
- Scores each trend by viral velocity, cross-platform confirmation, and monetization potential.
- Predicts trend migration between platforms and identifies first-mover windows.
- Automatically generates complete content briefs for each detected trend.
- Produces ready-to-publish, viral-optimized video content via InVideo AI in 20 minutes.
